name: cc-fuzzer
description: LLM-in-the-loop coverage-guided fuzzing for C/C++ with strict, schema-driven, deterministic state. v0.14 adds: a pinned reproducible toolchain via Nix flake (flake.nix in plugin root); FHSEnv-wrapped devShell so AFL++/SymCC/clang/llvm-cov see the FHS layout they were written for; SessionStart hook detects whether Claude is running inside the cc-fuzzer dev shell and reports cc_fuzzer_fhs_active / nix_shell_other / host_tools status; install-symcc.sh prints a banner suggesting nix as the preferred path. Layer 2 (declarative harness derivations) is on the roadmap and explicitly out of scope for this release. Schema unchanged at v6. Architecture inspired by OSS-CRS, Buttercup, OSS-Fuzz-Gen, and Atlantis-Multilang. v0.15 adds: process-based fuzzing mode (fuzzing_mode field in harness-built/v5); deterministic harness teardown via kill-harness-processes.sh; /cc-fuzzer:report command with Opus reporting-agent that re-runs reproducers and writes FINDINGS-REPORT.md; SymCC /nix/store PATH fallback. State schema bumped to v7.
